name: Echoes
source:
What began as an ordinary life for Henry quickly descended into chaos. Unexplained events twisted his reality, each choice bringing unexpected repercussions, as a dark, watchful presence loomed behind him.

[From [url=https://sesko56.itch.io/echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亨利原本平凡的生活很快就陷入混乱。无法解释的事件扭曲了他的现实，每一个选择都会带来意想不到的后果，一个黑暗、警惕的存在隐约出现在他身后。

[来自[url=https://sesko56.itch.io/echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
